title: Captain Rex
subtitle: Galactic Republic
description: Clone Captain Rex fought in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, serving under Anakin Skywalker and the Padawan Ahsoka Tano. He was loyal and honorable, putting his faith in the Jedi Generals he served. When the order to execute the Jedi came from Darth Sidious, Rex struggled to resist it. He was lucky Ahsoka Tano was nearby and was able to remove his inhibitor chip.
